clauses.scope_note: Covers Bailian model inference, model-square experience, application tools, and AI subscriptions. This explanation supplements the two named service agreements and prevails over inconsistent terms; continuing use or experience signifies acceptance.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_or_experience_covered_bailian_service_or_function means use or experience of a service or function listed in this paragraph. The referenced agreements are incorporated but not provided in full.

clauses.scope_note: Provider may adjust AI subscription auto-renewal functionality and upgrade strategy, including changing or stopping auto-renewal, by prior website announcement or in-site message.
clauses.condition_explanation: ai_subscription_has_auto_renewal_or_upgrade_strategy identifies the relevant subscription feature; advance notice is required.

clauses.scope_note: For Token Plan team-edition SSO, authentication is to be completed by the enterprise registered to the relevant Aliyun account. The user or represented enterprise must keep the SSO account and API Key secure.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_token_plan_team_sso means using SSO login for Token Plan team edition.

obligation_items.content: Ensure the SSO account and API Key are secure.
obligation_items.object: Token Plan team SSO account and API Key
obligation_items.trigger: When using Token Plan team edition SSO.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian undertakes to provide basic after-sales support during the purchased service term through the listed channels; the following paragraphs specify the support scope.
clauses.condition_explanation: during_purchased_service_term means while the customer's purchased service term remains active.

obligation_items.content: Provide the stated basic after-sales support through the listed channels during the purchased service term.
obligation_items.object: Basic after-sales support for the Bailian service

clauses.scope_note: After-sales support is to follow the customer-service-benefits standard published on the Aliyun website; the referenced standard is not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: meet_published_customer_service_benefits_standard refers to the external customer-service-benefits webpage.

obligation_items.content: Provide after-sales support according to the published customer-service-benefits standard.
obligation_items.trigger: When providing the relevant after-sales support.

clauses.scope_note: Paid after-sales value-added support, including support plans, takes effect for use only after ordering it on the Aliyun website. Other paid after-sales services are subject to their webpage terms; deeper project support is recommended, not required.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_paid_value_added_after_sales_support means receiving a paid after-sales support offering.

clauses.scope_note: Free experience may be subject to quota limits. Product-page instructions and rules are external and not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_free_experience_service means using a free experience offering; applicable limits are those shown on the product page.

obligation_items.content: Observe applicable experience instructions and rules displayed on the product page, including quota limits.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using a free experience service.

clauses.scope_note: The provider may cancel activity eligibility and reclaim resources for malicious resource occupation, batch order manipulation, or other unconventional conduct affecting activity fairness.
clauses.condition_explanation: participate_in_experience_activity means participation in the described activity; the listed conduct may result in loss of eligibility and resource recovery.

obligation_items.content: Do not maliciously occupy activity resources, manipulate activity through batch orders, or use other unconventional means to affect activity fairness.
obligation_items.trigger: During participation in an experience activity.

clauses.scope_note: Provider may change or adjust activity rules and product quantities according to operations; benefits already obtained before a change are unaffected.
clauses.condition_explanation: experience_activity_operation_changes means the provider changes activity terms or quantities in response to operations.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits removing or altering the “AI generated” label added by the experience service.
clauses.condition_explanation: experience_service_added_ai_generated_label means the experience service has added the relevant label.

obligation_items.content: Do not remove or alter the experience service’s AI-generated label.
obligation_items.trigger: When the experience service has added the label.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to model-experience input and output, collectively defined as user content. The provider states it collects user content; personal data included in input will necessarily be collected and may appear in output. No ownership grant is stated.
clauses.condition_explanation: provide_or_use_experience_user_content means submitting input or using the corresponding output. The text asks users to ensure input contains no personal information, and to comply with applicable law if personal data is included; it also requires ensuring content does not infringe third-party rights and avoiding potentially unlawful or public-morality-violating input.

obligation_items.content: Ensure input contains no personal information; if personal data is included, comply with applicable law.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever interacting with model-experience functions, including if personal data is included.

obligation_items.content: Ensure user content does not infringe third-party legitimate rights and avoid input that may violate law or public morality.
obligation_items.object: Experience-service user content, including input and output
obligation_items.trigger: When providing or using user content in model-experience interactions.

clauses.scope_note: Provider discloses collection of experience-service input and output; personal data in input may be reflected in output. This is a processing disclosure, not an unrestricted data-use grant.
clauses.condition_explanation: provide_or_use_experience_user_content means submitting input or using the corresponding output. The clause does not specify a broader purpose or retention period for this experience-service collection.

clauses.scope_note: For model-square voice-replication experience, uploaded audio must be a recording of the user's own voice; third-party and minor voices are prohibited. Provider states the original voice is deleted after task completion and is not stored or used.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_model_square_voice_replication_experience means choosing a model-square voice-replication experience feature.

obligation_items.content: Upload only audio recording the user's own voice.
Do not use a third party's or a minor's voice recording.

clauses.scope_note: Completed voice replicas support experience-purpose use only. Provider also states the original voice is deleted after task completion and is not stored or used.
clauses.condition_explanation: voice_replication_task_completed means the voice-replication task has finished; experience_purpose_only limits use of the completed replica to the experience purpose.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the completed voice replica for purposes other than experiencing the feature.
obligation_items.trigger: After a voice-replication task is completed.

clauses.scope_note: Experience-generated content may be used only to experience model effects; commercial use and providing it to third parties or using, propagating, or distributing it on third-party platforms are prohibited. The user does not claim IP in generated content unless otherwise stated.
clauses.condition_explanation: content_generated_during_experience_interaction means content generated through model experience. The stated restrictions apply to that generated content.

obligation_items.content: Do not use experience-generated content for any purpose other than experiencing model effects, including commercial purposes.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using content generated during an experience interaction.

obligation_items.content: Do not provide the generated content to a third party or use, propagate, or distribute it on any third-party platform.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever handling or using content generated during an experience interaction.

coverage_notes: The referenced Aliyun product-service agreement, Bailian service agreement, customer-service-benefits standard, product-page experience rules, and third-party agreements are not supplied in full; their additional terms cannot be inferred.

The provider's promise to delete original voice after completion and not store or use it is an operative provider-side data commitment that the available activity/object schema does not faithfully represent; it remains unresolved.
The input/output collection statement is a disclosure, not an unrestricted data-use grant. No general output license or transfer of ownership is inferred.
